purpose: Teach: 甚だ/へた/恐る恐る/とてつもない/なにかと/めずらしく/ほんのり/つき合い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの体調は甚だ心配ね
lines.en: Sho, I'm quite worried about how Grandpa's doing.
lines.style: Gentle concern, like she's thinking aloud. Soft pace. The warmth of speaking to a child who might understand more than expected.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きへたで悲しい
lines.en: Mom, I'm sad because I'm not good at drawing.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact disappointment. No self-pity — just a small observation offered up like a fact. Quiet but not whispered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは恐る恐る初挑戦の料理をされたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad made his first attempt at cooking, very carefully.
lines.style: Warm amusement underneath. Not mocking — affectionate. Slight smile in the voice. Speaking to Sho like he'd appreciate the gentle humor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんから、とてつもない大きなおもちゃもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa gave me this incredibly huge toy!
lines.style: Bright excitement. Quick tempo. The rush of a small discovery shared immediately. Open, unguarded. A child who can't quite contain the joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは、なにかと心配して下さるのよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad worries about so many things and takes care of us, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, patient explanation. Not lecturing. Speaking as if helping him see something kind about his father. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、今日はめずらしく早起きしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I woke up really early today, which is unusual for me.
lines.style: Small pride in the voice. Not boastful — just pleased with himself. A quiet achievement he wants her to notice. Straightforward, earnest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがほんのり微笑まれてたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma was smiling so softly just now.
lines.style: Tender observation. Slow pace. Speaking like she's noticing something precious and wants him to see it too. Warm, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達とのつき合いも大事にするよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to really care about my friendships too.
lines.style: Sincere, earnest commitment. Not rushing — weight behind the words. A child making a small promise to himself out loud. Steady eye-contact in the voice.
